title: sync_worktree_cells never deletes tracked cell files
action: P1 fix-first: wsh-1's sync_worktree_cells prunes foreign-feature cell files from the island store — but .bee/cells/** is git-TRACKED, so git worktree add legitimately checks those files out and the prune manufactures tracked DELETIONS that a later worktree merge would apply to MAIN, wiping the cell archive (caught live pre-merge on beehive--wt--worktree-manifest-native). Fix in registry.rs: the prune arm asks git whether the file is tracked (git ls-files --error-unmatch or an ls-files set computed once) and deletes ONLY untracked strays; tracked foreign-feature cells stay on disk untouched. The fill arm (granted feature's cells copied in when missing) and the zero-cells case stay exactly as wsh-1 shipped. Update wsh-1's tests: the mixed-feature fixture must distinguish tracked vs untracked foreign cells — tracked survive, untracked pruned; add a regression asserting git status in the island is CLEAN after bootstrap (no deletions manufactured). Keep the whole suite green.

truths: bootstrap leaves the island git-clean — zero manufactured deletions
untracked foreign stray cells are still pruned
the fill arm and zero-cells behavior are unchanged

artifacts.substantive: tracked-aware prune plus updated tests, no TODO stubs

trace.outcome: sync_worktree_cells computes tracked set once (git ls-files); both prune passes skip tracked entries; git-unavailable = prune nothing; P1 regression pin: island git-status clean after bootstrap from real worktree checkout
